build_cell_lstm: build an LSTM RNN cell with configurable layers, dropout, and layer normalization
build_cell_rhn: build an RHN RNN cell with sparse tiled linear layers and configurable depth
build_cell_nas: build a NASCell RNN with neural architecture search support and skip connections
build_cell_sparse_tiled: build a tiled RNN cell with sparse weight matrices and sparsity ratio
build_cell_overlayed: build a tiled RNN cell with overlayed weight sharing across gates
